# uncertainty_observation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Represents typed UNKNOWN uncertainty instead of manufacturing false certainty.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|

| `confidence_basis` | `string` | yes | Basis for any confidence estimate. |
| `standing` | `string` | yes | Machine-readable UNKNOWN-compatible standing. |
